cards.ex: Don't lose heart! You'll find a job eventually.
cards.exUz: Umidsizlikka tushmang! Oxir-oqibat ish topasiz.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlikka berilmoq, ruhini tushirmoq, motivatsiyani yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: I don't want to give you false hope, but it might be possible.
cards.exUz: Sizga soxta umid bermoqchi emasman, lekin bu mumkin bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: There's still a glimmer of hope that they'll find him alive.
cards.exUz: Uni tirik topishlariga hali ham umid uchquni bor.

cards.ex: She's been down in the dumps ever since she failed the exam.
cards.exUz: U imtihondan yiqilganidan beri tushkun kayfiyatda.

cards.ex: After losing his job, he really hit rock bottom.
cards.exUz: Ishidan ayrilganidan keyin, u haqiqatan ham tubga yetdi.

cards.ex: I began to despair of ever finding my keys.
cards.exUz: Men hech qachon kalitlarimni topishdan umid uzdim.

cards.ex: The doctor's words offered a ray of hope to the family.
cards.exUz: Doktorning so'zlari oilaga umid nurini taqdim etdi.

cards.ex: Don't pin all your hopes on getting that promotion.
cards.exUz: Butun umidingizni o'sha lavozimga ko'tarilishga bog'lamang.

cards.ex: The team is clutching at straws, trying anything to win.
cards.exUz: Jamoa g'alaba qozonish uchun har qanday chorani ko'rmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nodonona chorani umid bilan qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: The bad news dashed all our hopes of a vacation.
cards.exUz: Yomon xabar bizning ta'til umidimizni yo'q qildi.
cards.uzDef: Umiddan mahrum qilmoq, umidni yo'q qilmoq.

cards.ex: The situation seems beyond hope at this point.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat hozirgi paytda umidsiz ko'rinadi.

cards.ex: He's always building castles in the air instead of taking action.
cards.exUz: U har doim harakat qilish o'rniga havoda qasrlar quradi.

cards.ex: They never gave up hope of finding their lost dog.
cards.exUz: Ular hech qachon yo'qolgan itini topishdan umid uzmadilar.

cards.ex: She cried out in despair when she heard the news.
cards.exUz: U xabarni eshitgach, umidsizlikdan qichqirib yubordi.

cards.ex: Even after so many failures, hope springs eternal.
cards.exUz: Ko'p muvaffaqiyatsizliklardan keyin ham, umid abadiy.

cards.ex: Keep your chin up! Things will get better.
cards.exUz: Ruhingni ko'tar! Hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

cards.ex: He got caught in a downward spiral of debt and depression.
cards.exUz: U qarz va depressiyaning pastga qarab ketayotgan spiraliga tushib qoldi.

cards.ex: I'm starting to lose faith in the justice system.
cards.exUz: Men adolat tizimiga bo'lgan ishonchimni yo'qota boshladim.

cards.ex: I'm at the end of my rope with this project.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu loyiha bilan tojdan o'tdim.
cards.term: at the end of your rope

cards.ex: She has an optimistic outlook on life, even in difficult times.
cards.exUz: U hatto qiyin paytlarda ham hayotga optimistik qarashga ega.

cards.ex: I hate going to the dentist, but I have to bite the bullet.
cards.exUz: Tish shifokoriga borishni yomon ko'raman, lekin men sabr qilishim kerak.

cards.ex: He knew he had to face the music for his actions.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlari uchun javob berishi kerakligini bilar edi.

cards.ex: The new strategy helped to turn the tide in the war.
cards.exUz: Yangi strategiya urushdagi vaziyatni o'zgartirishga yordam berdi.

cards.ex: After months of hard work, we can finally see the light at the end of the tunnel.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oylik mehnatdan so'ng, nihoyat tunnel oxiridagi nurni ko'rishimiz mumkin.

cards.ex: Even though it rained, we tried to look on the bright side and enjoy the day.
cards.exUz: Yomg'ir yog'gan bo'lsa ham, biz yaxshi tomonga qarashga va kundan zavqlanishga harakat qildik.

cards.ex: Stop with all the doom and gloom! Things aren't that bad.
cards.exUz: Barcha yomon bashoratlaringizni to'xtating! Hammasi unchalik ham yomon emas.

cards.ex: There's still a faint hope that they'll change their minds.
cards.exUz: Ularning fikrini o'zgartirishiga hali ham zaif umid bor.

cards.ex: Without education, many young people face a bleak future.
cards.exUz: Ta'limsiz ko'p yoshlar qorong'u kelajakga duch kelishadi.

cards.ex: After the tragedy, she was in the depths of despair.
cards.exUz: Fojadan keyin u umidsizlik tubida edi.

cards.ex: I was going to ask her out, but I lost my nerve at the last minute.
cards.exUz: Men undan uchrashuvga taklif qilmoqchi edim, lekin oxirgi daqiqada jur'atimni yo'qotdim.
